name: A.E.G.I.S. Chestplate
description: An industrial-edged curiass reinforced by carbon fiber.

name: A.E.G.I.S. Greaves
description: Protective leg-wear with multi-layer carbon fiber reinforcement.

name: A.E.G.I.S. Helmet
description: Heavy duty head protection, reinforced with carbon fiber.
flavor: Armor-Enhanced Guardian Impact System doesn't exactly roll off the tongue.

name: A.E.G.I.S. Pauldrons
description: Carbon-reinforced arm protection.

name: A.T.O.M.S. Chestplate
description: Significantly enhanced chest shielding.

name: A.T.O.M.S. Greaves
description: Powerfully upgraded protective leg-wear.

name: A.T.O.M.S. Helmet
description: Heavily reinforced head protection elevated from its industrial origins.
flavor: Attempts of getting anyone to refer to it as the Advanced Tactical Outer Mechanized Shielding have yielded few takers, but persistence generally pays off, so keep trying.

name: A.T.O.M.S. Pauldrons
description: Highly advanced arm protections.

name: Accursed Hood
description: A sturdy cloth-draped mask with careful spiral woodwork, reminiscent of the natural weavings of the Hexwood from which it's carved.
flavor: The compulsively-carpentered woodgrain stirs with what can only be described as longing, somewhere deep underneath your skin. Fractured visions shoot across your mind, of etched stone encasing writhing meat, or... it's simply a metaphor for bark, encasing a tree. You're compelled to run your hand along the woodgrain one more time.
summary: While worn, the hostile Hexed Trees in Canaan will not attack the player, even after being attacked themselves. The item also states that "you receive more favorable trades with Anteverse XXXIII", but this affects nothing. Accursed Hood cannot be repaired, but regenerates 2 points of durability every 60 seconds.

name: Alpha Helmet
description: A helmet made from a rare, red Peccary.

name: Alpine Pack
description: An artic pack for cold-weather mountaineering.
summary: Alpine Pack is a gear item in Abiotic Factor. Similar to the Research Pack, it has 30 inventory slots with better weight reduction. It also has +1 cold resistance.

name: Anteplate Gauntlets
description: Highly-protective arm defense leveraging the mortal remains of exotic creatures and some other nifty stuff.

name: Anteplate Helm
description: An extremely heavy-duty helmet that wears its bio-scavenged origins proudly.

name: Anteplate Plackart
description: Strengthened body armor largely crafted from armored bodies.

name: Anteplate Sabatons
description: Hardened and reinforced leg defenses forged from defensive insects, amongst other things.

name: Baseball Cap
description: A sporty baseball cap.

name: Basic Backpack
description: A very small backpack.
summary: Basic Backpack is a gear item in Abiotic Factor. It allows the player to carry more items.

name: Beanie
description: A cozy beanie.

name: Beekeeper Suit
description: A suit purpose-built for protecting the wearer from all kinds of stinging insects, without doing much else.

name: Behemoth Helmet
description: A helmet made from the head of a colossal brute.

name: Bindings of Malediction
description: The protection these gauntlets grant goes beyond the mundane, starting with the name.
summary: Bindings of Malediction cannot be repaired, but regenerates 2 points of durability every 60 seconds.

name: Bio-Fusion Imitator
description: A field-generating imitator that sends a low electrical signal through the wearer's body, allowing the operation of artifact weapons and overriding any lower tier bio-metric lockouts.
summary: Bio-Fusion Imitator is a trinket in Abiotic Factor. Crafting it requires Level 18 Accuracy.

name: Bio-Metric Armwraps
description: These armwraps don't provide much armour, but they do allow the wearer to operate certain weapons.
summary: It is required to able to use the Montese SMG, Talagi Magnum and Romag Shotgun.

name: Bio-Mimic Armwraps
description: These armwraps don't provide much armor, but they do allow the wearer to operate special weapons.
summary: Bio-Mimic Armwraps is a gear item in Abiotic Factor. Crafting or equipping them requires Level 15 Accuracy.

name: Bionic Legs
description: Cobbled together by ingenuity, and a bit of hope, these legs will allow the wearer to move faster and land harder.
flavor: Stronger. Faster. Eh, you know the rest.
summary: Wearing them make it so the player character's legs can not break from falling from high heights and grants a +20% increase in movement speed.

name: Blacksmithing Apron
description: A very heavy apron used by blacksmiths.
flavor: Apparently blacksmiths still exist. Who knew?
summary: * Despite providing little armor to begin with Blacksmithing Apron is coded specifically to not protect against Sharp Damage. Category: Chest Armor

name: Blacksmithing Gloves
description: Very heavy gloves, typically worn by metalworkers.
summary: === Manufacturing West === * In the Supply Room. * Going past The Blacksmith, in a room with some tents set up. * In the container up above, where The Blacksmith is. * Inside Shipping, heading towards Shipping Logistics. There is a man called Hank. From here: ** Go upstairs, right, and into the small office room. The Gloves are on the desk. ** Go through his office and near the crane, on a single GATE Box are the Gloves. ** Go straight; at the end, turn left through the containers with metal ramps, on the right before the yellow doors are boxes, near them are the Gloves.

name: Bonnet
description: Seemly headwear from a bygone age.
summary: === Security Sector === * The grey Bonnet can be found on a Lab Rat's corpse in the Security Sector, next to the Order Terminal between doors 3 and 4.

name: Breacher Helmet
description: A helmet of military make, adorned with strange markings and iron bars laid across the face shield.
flavor: The Breachers are paying penance, deployed on the front lines with a constant reminder of their guilt.

name: Breastplate of Hex
description: Body armor crafted from the wood of an extremely unusual tree.
summary: Breastplate of Hex cannot be repaired, but regenerates 2 points of durability every 60 seconds.

name: Bucket Hat
description: A utilitarian sun protector.
summary: There are currently four variants in-game, a blue, grey, red and green variant.

name: CQC Helmet
description: Heavy duty head protection for combat and cold.
flavor: Regardless of its authenticity, a solid piece of frontline armor.

name: Captain's Beret
description: A beret worn by what appear to be the squad leaders. It features some sort of rune on the front.
summary: The Blacksmith will sell 1 Blacksmithing Gloves for 1 Captain's Beret. Category:Head Armor

name: Carapace Gauntlets
description: A chitinous set of arm protectors, built from slain beasts and bit of scientific engineering.

name: Carapace Helm
description: A sturdy helmet built from some lab equipment and alien carapace.

name: Carapace Plackart
description: A strong chestplate built from the shells of insects and a few other things.

name: Carapace Sabatons
description: Leg protection built from the backs of many foes with some laboratory scrap holding it all together.

name: Carbuncle Balloon
description: A floating flesh-balloon that reduces pack weight.

name: Carbuncle Crest
description: A purple pinnacle of perfection.
flavor: You are queen of the carbuncles. Which... doesn't really mean much.

name: Carbuncle Crown
description: A fancy hat cobbled accordingly from the carcass of a contemptible carbuncle.
flavor: You are king of the carbuncles. Which... doesn't really mean much.

name: Cascade Gauntlets
description: Strong arm covers to keep threats at bay.

name: Cascade Hauberk
description: Science combines with ingenuity to create a chestplate that's effective, light and just a little bit comfy.

name: Cascade Helm
description: A strong high-tech helm with a premium visor, provided there's enough of the system present.

name: Cascade Legplates
description: Leg armor made from strong metal alloys and a heap of science.

name: Cerenkov Legplates
description: Steel-clad legplates, tempered by hot, radioactive spillage and bound together by digital question marks.

name: Charge Shield
description: A shield that delivers an electric shock when struck.
summary: Charge Shield is a gear item placed in the Off-Hand Armaments slot of the inventory in Abiotic Factor.

name: Chef Apron
description: A classic mess-preventing cooking apron.
flavor: Let's shed some light on the subject.
summary: === Office Sector === * Level 1 ** Cafeteria kitchen. * Level 2 ** Kitchen between Gym locker room and Data Farm. ** Close to Security Office locker room. * Level 3 ** Break Room. ** Small kitchen area under the Analysis Office.

name: Chef Hat
description: The hallmark of a true chef.
flavor: Well, you LOOK like you can cook, anyway.
summary: === Office Sector === * Level 1 ** In the Cafeteria's kitchen. ** In the men's bathroom, inside the janitor's closet. * Level 2 ** Kitchen between the Gym locker room and the Data Farm. * Level 3 ** In the break room. ** Small kitchen area under the Analysis Office.

name: Chieftain Pack
description: A rugged, customised backpack focused on field utility, with just a smidge of aegis.
summary: Chieftain Pack is a gear item in Abiotic Factor. It allows the player to carry more items.

name: Clamp Shield
description: A shield that projects a rapid-flux vacuum field to temporarily freeze attackers.
flavor: Underpinned by the same vacuum field manipulation that brought you Hardlight technology.
summary: Clamp Shield is a gear item placed in the Off-Hand Armaments slot of the inventory in Abiotic Factor.

name: Cold Storage Pack
description: A large, heavily-insulated field backpack with a dedicated freezer pocket and dual cooling sections.
summary: It can hold 30 items, reduces weight by 22%. It has 1 Freezer Slot and 2 Refrigerated Slots.

name: Commander's Cap
description: A suitably weather-worn cap that sits atop the head of all commanders of a Planetary Legion.
flavor: A tag on the inseam reads "Licensed by LycoSoft E.P.E." and has a series of pictograms indicating proper machine-wash instructions.
summary: Commander's Cap is a gear item in Abiotic Factor. It is the same cap worn by Commander Fili in Royal Range.

name: Containment Gloves
description: Long purple gloves, typically worn by those handing precious objects.
summary: === Cascade Laboratories === * Level 2 ** In the Wildlife Pens. ** In the Supply Room close to the Lobby. ** In the Containment area, in the Assessment room. ** In the Containment area, inside a room close to a Containment Bot. ** In the Containment area, in the locker room upstairs from the Tram station. ** In the Containment area, in the back of a truck that is in the large area where the Tarasque is. ** In the Containment area, inside of a cell with a Snag Vine Seed, close to where Dr. Petra Peters is. * Level 3 ** In Adjustment, in a small room on the second level where there are some cabi

name: Core Companion
description: A cold stone with a very soft glow. Pets seem to respond positively to it.
flavor: Forged from other-worldy remains with a residual connection to their origin, this potent idol channels forces from the recently-discovered Anteverse 299.

name: Corn Husk Doll
description: An unsightly doll made from the raw husks of fetid corn.
flavor: We all remember childhood differently.
summary: Wearing it reduces the rate at which Hunger decreases by 50%, but also reduces the player's maximum HP by 15%.

name: Cowboy Hat
description: A leather cowboy hat.

name: Crystalline Casque
description: Lightweight head armor crafted from crystalline remains.
flavor: Little is known about IS-0139, but the crystal remains have some unique optical properties when combined with the right technology to activate it.

name: Crystalline Couters
description: Light but protective crystalline arm protection
flavor: More durable than it looks.

name: Crystalline Cuirass
description: Jagged and reflective armor created from curious dust.

name: Crystalline Cuisses
description: Crystalline, lightweight leg protection.

name: Crystalline Vial
description: A small crystalline shard, emitting a purple light in response to conductivity in the air.
summary: When equipped, the Crystalline Vial will reveal invisible entities, such as the crystalline IS-0139 when nearby the player. It will also passively charge any items in the player's inventory that has a battery, at a rate of 1 energy point every 4 seconds. This does not work on items charged by laser.

name: Cushion Chestplate
description: A big chestplate made from cloth, tape and stuffing.

name: Dangling Gravity Cube
description: An unusual cube that makes people feel a little lighter than normal...
flavor: Created from IS-0052.
summary: It allows the player to jump higher and slow their descent when falling. It also emits a short-ranged blue light around the player character when equipped.

name: Diving Suit
description: A diving suit with a rebreather for extended underwater journeys
summary: While worn, swim speed is doubled, the player can stay underwater for much longer before needing to surface for air, and grants the abilitity to see much clearer underwater like the Swim Goggles do.

name: Driving Cap
description: A comfy cap.

name: Dunkeltaler Backpack
description: A yellow backpack from just below the treeline.
flavor: The backpack appears to be from Fisch-N-Holz Survival and Hardware.
summary: Dunkeltaler Backpack is a gear item in Abiotic Factor. It allows the player to carry more items.

name: Egg Head
description: An oval hat no doubt created by a scientist who has truly lost their marbles.
flavor: You know what you are, why not embrace it?

name: Employee Locator
description: A signal beacon that detects the pagers of nearby GATE employees.
flavor: A small bit of writing on the label: May not detect all nearby GATE employees, hiding employees, or entities pretending to be GATE employees.
summary: While the Employee Locator is worn, the player can see other nearby scientists and NPCs through walls and obstacles. The Employee Locator also makes the wearer visible to other nearby players. Players can hide and negate the effect by sneaking.

name: Excursion Suit
description: A full-body hyper-mobility exosuit based on experimental GATE electro-active polymer research and some even more speculative technology.
flavor: The original Synaptic Labs brief invited designs for a wearable lightweight, speed-enhancing suit to assist multi-axis movement with reduced effort. Nothing made it off the drawing board, until now.
summary: Enables double-jumping, increases movement speed by 20%, decreases aim sway by 0.025, reduces radiation absorbed by 25%, and decreases stamina drain by 25%.

name: Exor Hood
description: A broad plate of skull and bone from an all-too common foe.
flavor: As if injected into your mind, the design of this armor channels something deeper, something older.

name: Exor Shinguards
description: Thick plates of boney barricade.

name: Exor Spines
description: Ridges of bone and spike, quill and carapace.

name: Exor Straps
description: Strong shell, embracing stronger bone.

name: Exsurgo Armwraps
description: Protective armwear acquired from an Order medic.

name: Exsurgo Shinguards
description: Flexible leg defenses once worn by those often required to kneel in the field.

name: Exsurgo Tactical Plate
description: Heavy-duty tactical body armor from an unfortunate Order medic.
flavor: Reworked over centuries, the Exsurgo's body armor still retains hints of its debt to Egyptian medicine.

name: Extemp Armwraps
description: Hastily devised arm defense, upgraded to provide decent protection.

name: Extemp Chestplate
description: Improvised chest defense enhanced to an impressive degree.

name: Extemp Helmet
description: Ad hoc head protection elevated to respectable armor.
flavor: The true process of creation: improvise, improve, polish, accept.

name: Extemp Legwraps
description: Swiftly constructed leg armor, considerably improved.

name: Exulum Bindings
description: Tightly bound arm protection designed for an Order Exulum.
flavor: Intended to confine and protect.

name: Exulum Ribcage
description: Heavy frontline chest armor emblazoned with Order arcana.
flavor: The reinforcement of this chestplate reflects the position of Exulum, deployed on the frontline to redeem greivous lapses in honor.

name: Exulum Shackles
description: Hardened leg defenses intended for a disgraced Order Exulum.

name: F.O.R.G.E. Chestplate
description: A quickly-fashioned cuirass.

name: F.O.R.G.E. Greaves
description: Industrial leg protection.

name: F.O.R.G.E. Helmet
description: A decent attempt at actual head protection.

name: F.O.R.G.E. Pauldrons
description: A better-than-basic pair of protective arm wraps.

name: Field Sample Pack
description: A large, heavily-insulated field backpack with multiple radiation containment slots for perfect shielding while transporting hazardous materials.
summary: The Field Sample Pack changes the Cooling Slot of the Research Pack for a Warming Slot (which causes cold items to decay faster and hot items like Mug of Coffee to stay hot longer), and adds one additional radiation Shielded Slot in the inventory, bringing the total to 2 radiation Shielded Slots.

name: Fire Proximity Suit
description: Worn by volcano researchers and molten manufacturing workers. Blocks most exposure to high heat and flame.
summary: Fire Proximity Suit is a gear item in Abiotic Factor. While equipped, the wearer gains a much higher heat tolerance from areas such as The Mycofields.

name: Floppy Hat
description: A snug hat to keep even the coldest scientist toasty and warm.
summary: There are currently two variants of the Floppy Hat in-game, a blue and orange variant.

name: Fog Lantern
description: A humming lantern that seems to react when in the presence of lingering water vapor.
summary: The Fog Lantern gives the Fog Lantern status effect, which halves stamina drain. This effect only applies during a Fog Phenomenon, in Flathill, or when wearing the full set of Maestro Armor. The Fog Lantern also acts as bait for the Chordfish, increasing the chance of catching the fish in appropriate waters (i.e. the Flathill fountain) and allowing the rare variant of the fish, the Osseous Chordfish, to be caught.

name: Gardening Gloves
description: Rough green gloves, typically worn by gardeners and those working with thorny plants.

name: Geiger Counter Keychain
description: A compact device that detects radiation in the immediate area.
summary: Wearing it causes a permanent reading of the Environmental Radiation to appear above the Hotbar, as if a regular Geiger Counter was held in hand. However, it cannot display readings of the player's radiation dosage. If a Geiger Counter is held while the Geiger Counter Keychain is equipped, its display replaces the Keychain's.

name: Gel Tube
description: A small tube that emits a comfy orange glow.
summary: It emits a short-ranged orange light source around the player character when equipped.

name: Giant's Pack
description: A large carrying case from a fallen Gatekeeper of enormous stature.
flavor: Utilizing hyper-generative biomaterials recovered from Anteverse 42, Gatekeepers began a series of experiments, in conjunction with GATE, designed to 'productively enhance' human size and strength.
summary: Giant's Pack is a gear item in Abiotic Factor. It allows the player to carry more items.

name: Glitch Pack
description: A strange multi-purpose pack with ultra-dimensional properties and a variety of slots for cooling, warming, and radioactive protection.
flavor: There remains no assurance that reaching into this backpack will return your hand intact.
summary: It has 1 Shielded Slot, 1 Refrigerated Slot, 1 Freezer Slot and 1 Warming Slot.

name: Glow Shard
description: A small anomalous gem that constantly emits a white light.
flavor: Created from IS:0010.
summary: It emits a short-ranged white light source around the player character when equipped.

name: Golden Wreath
description: An exquisitely crafted wreath of purest gold.
flavor: The ancients believed perfection offends the gods. Clearly not all the ancients.
summary: === Temple of Stone === * In a room available after completing it's secret puzzle on a statue. Category:Head Armor

name: Greek Bracers
description: Classic, if basic, arm protection for old-world infantry.

name: Greek Greaves
description: Light leg protection that will not interfere with movement, or enemy weapons, either, really.

name: Greek Helmet
description: A helmet, more polished than one might think, but the quality of metal is subject to the opinion of the material sciences.
flavor: It's technically Corinthian, which adds further questions left unanswered by its rigidly slient owner.

name: Greek Linothorax
description: Lightweight chest protection in the hoplite tradition.

name: Hard Hat
description: A durable helmet to protect warehouse workers.
summary: The Hard Hat has seven different color variants. These colors are red, yellow, green, blue, white, grey, and brown.

name: Hardlight Shield
description: A magnificent and anti-material shield of dazzling hardlight, if it’s got charge.
summary: Hardlight Shield is a gear item placed in the Off-Hand Armaments slot of the inventory in Abiotic Factor. A shield with a refractable shield made of hardlight, capable of deflecting enemy projectiles.

name: Hardlight Shield Generator
description: A repurposed Gatekeeper hardlight shield, adding another layer of protection when worn.
flavor: A sort of technological palimpsest, this protective force field emitter was created from a broken Gatekeeper hardlight shield, which was itself created by GATE’s Synaptic Labs from a reverse-engineered device from Anteverse 8.
summary: Produces a Hardlight Shield that blocks physical attacks. It has 150 health. It regenerates 10 shield health per second, after a delay of 7 seconds when damaged and 15 seconds when fully depleted. When the trinket is equipped, it starts at 0 shield health and has a 15 second delay before it recharges. Equipped armor values do not impact how much damage the shield can absorb.

name: Hasta Tria's Right Boot
description: A boot worn deep with travel, worn raw with time.
flavor: Quod obstat viae fit via.
summary: For 5 minutes after traveling through any portal, items collected from a resource node have a 40% chance per node to have their quantities increased by 1. Portals include those leading to and from Anteverses, portals generated by Teleporter Pads, and most other similar effects, but does not include Personal Teleporters.

name: Hazardous Materials Suit
description: Worn by scientists to study radiation and biohazardous materials. Greatly reduces radiation buildup.
summary: * Level 2 ** In a room upstairs from the lobby, close to the toilets. ** In the Wildlife Pens. ** Two can be found close to where the Dark Lens was stolen from and close to Dr. Newman, where the portal to Rise opens up. * Level 3 ** In Adjustment, close to a Dr. Manse Hologram. ** In Adjustment, two can be found upstairs, close to some lockers. ** In Adjustment, inside the Holding Cell (accessed by being captured by the nearby Containment Bot or through a nearby hatch above a dumpster).

name: Heater Shield
description: Portable protection that brings the heat.
summary: Heater Shield is a gear item placed in the Off-Hand Armaments slot of the inventory in Abiotic Factor.

name: Hexwood Shield
description: The wood of this shield seems to spread and grow with a will of its own, or maybe with the will of its wielder. It is difficult to tell.
flavor: Being cleaved from its origin has not undone whatever force corrupted this Canaanite wood.
summary: Hexwood Shield is a gear item placed in the Off-Hand Armaments slot of the inventory in Abiotic Factor.

name: High Inquisitor Suit
description: An ornate, fullbody accoutrement indicating one has achieved the most supreme rank of Inquisitor.
flavor: The rank of High Inquisitor is regarded with equal amounts of veneration and suspicion, due to the necessary immersion in otherworldly artefacts that attainment of this echelon implies.

name: High-Vis Vest
description: For those who like being seen.
summary: There are currently two variants of the High-Vis Vest in-game, a orange and blue variant.

name: Hiking Pack
description: A large hiking backpack with a very supportive frame.

name: Horned Helmet
description: A horned helmet worn by the so-called Chieftains, patriarch of most Gatekeeper units.
flavor: The Chieftains seem to use anything at their disposal. Crosses, hexes, totems and iconography of all manner and design to discourage, thwart or otherwise turn evil the other way.

name: Hydroplant Hat
description: A hardy helmet to protect hydroplant workers.
summary: Hydroplant Hat is a gear item in Abiotic Factor. It seems to be an advanced Hard Hat with added hearing protection.

name: Hyperion Gauntlets
description: Unmatched defensive arm shielding that sacrifices nothing in the name of protection.

name: Hyperion Hauberk
description: Extremely enhanced and effective body armor with a few experimental tricks under the hood.

name: Hyperion Helm
description: High-tech head protection that balances extreme defensive capacity against the eternal risk of over-engineering.

name: Hyperion Legplates
description: Heavily armored and augmented leg defenses.

name: Interfection Katar
description: An offhand knife for quick stabs and parrying.
summary: Interfection Katar is a bladed weapon placed in the Off-Hand Armaments slot of the inventory in Abiotic Factor.

name: Interfector Breeches
description: Advanced, classical leg protection.

name: Interfector Chestwraps
description: Old world style meets modern materials in a surprisingly comfortable and limber armor system.

name: Interfector Helm
description: High-grade combat headwear adorned with chainmail coverings.
flavor: Interfectors cover their faces to symbolize isolation, perfection of spirit, and to honor a hermetic saint whose gnostic revelations continue to inform their sect.

name: Interfector Sleeves
description: Protective close-combat gauntlets.

name: Ionized Coreplate
description: A metallic encasing of nuclear-tempered alloy held together by an indecipherable digital interweave.

name: Jack O' Lantern Mask
description: A vegetal helmet with an orange rictus grin.
flavor: Greater churl was never known.

name: Jester Cap
description: The whimsical headwear of an old-world buffoon.
flavor: How this particular item arrived at the facility is a mystery, although a faint 'Jimbo' is discernable on the lining.
summary: === Office Sector === * Level 3 ** It is inside a room locked by a Tier 2 keypad above the entrance to Silo 3.

name: Jinxed Shinplates
description: Leg protection with a touch of the arcane...
summary: Jinxed Shinplates cannot be repaired, but regenerates 2 points of durability every 60 seconds.

name: Jolly Cap
description: A small, multicolour hat constructed from felt and dreams.
flavor: The size, style and minute stitching suggest small hands created this for a small head.

name: Jotunhelm
description: A helmet restored from the fallen remains of one of the Gatekeeper's best - and largest.
flavor: Exactly who suggested the moniker 'Jotun' is unclear, although it may have originated in the Gatekeepers' connection to the north.

name: Jugaar Armwraps
description: Arm protection, swiftly concocted, recently improved.

name: Jugaar Chestplate
description: Rapidly devised chest protection with some running improvements.

name: Jugaar Helmet
description: Protective headwear of an improved, yet still improvised nature.
flavor: Varsha Patel introduced the word 'jugaar' to engineers in Manufacturing Sector, and it seems to have caught on.

name: Jugaar Legwraps
description: Leg defense, hastily contrived, somewhat enhanced.

name: Karate Helmet
description: Makes getting punched in the head suck slightly less.
summary: Karate Helmet is a gear item in Abiotic Factor. The karate helmet has four color variants. These colors are red, blue, white, and grey.

name: Kintsugi Adornments
description: Ceramic-alloy body armor enhanced in both defense and aesthetics.

name: Kintsugi Casque
description: Ornate ceramic head armor infused with strengthening metallic fibers.
flavor: By its nature, Anteverse 1 seems to carry the very essence of wabi-sabi. Researchers at Crown and Cascade alike have hotly debated whether that is simply anthrocentric interpretation or one being provided by the mist-shrouded solivagant.

name: Kintsugi Greaves
description: Leg protection that's as effective as it is alluring.

name: Kintsugi Vambraces
description: Ceramic arm defense of the highest order.

name: Kite Shield
description: An old shield from a bygone age.
summary: Kite Shield is a gear item placed in the Off-Hand Armaments slot of the inventory in Abiotic Factor.

name: Kylie (Shield Generator)
description: An extremely dense data storage device parented to a personal shield generator. This unique unit allegedly contains the translated digital consciousness of Kylie Muir.
flavor: You made her a promise. Was this part of that promise?
summary: Upgrading Kylie into the Shield Generator trinket has no effect on her story. She does not retain the original trinket's buff of 10% experience gain for skills while equipped. If the player has talked to the Waterbot with Kylie equipped, she will occasionally speak to the player while equipped. She shows concern and offers encouragement while players are in combat, will warn the player of IS-0091 when it is nearby, will comment on reading terminals, and will bid players goodnight whenever they sleep. Kylie's Shield Generator form functions as an improved version of the original Hardlight Shiel

name: Kylie (Trinket)
description: An extremely dense data storage device, allegedly containing the translated digital consciousness of Kylie Muir.
flavor: You made her a promise, remember?.

name: Lab Gloves
description: Sleek white gloves, typically worn by lab workers.

name: Lab Mask
description: An airtight mask often used by those working with dangerous chemicals.
summary: The lab mask has nine color variants, all changing the color of the visor. These colors are clear, red, pink, yellow, orange, green, blue, purple, and black.

name: Larva Suit
description: A suit made from Larval remains. Renders the user less suspicious to larvae and their ilk.
flavor: If you put aside aesthetics, disgust and dignity, it's not just fine, it's almost comfy.
summary: Larvae are no longer hostile to a player wearing the suit (note that they will still be hostile to any deployed buildings), and the player is unaffected by the slowing effects of goo splats. The player's movement while wearing the suit is a little slippery, as if they are walking on ice. A player who is wearing the suit may speak to and trade with the Big Hive Larva (Trader).

name: Lead Vest
description: A heavy lead vest typically used to block harmful x-rays.
flavor: This could work as armor... For now.
summary: === Office Sector === * Level 2 ** Bio Lab D. ** Data Farms, close to Dr. Manse's Hologram. ** Security Office. * Level 3 ** Silo 3 viewing area. ** Small room under Analysis Office (between kitchen and Physics Lab D). ** Silo 3 ** Physics Lab D.

name: Legate Bracers
description: Reinforced arm defenses designed for an Order Legate.

name: Legate Chestplate
description: High quality body armor obtained from an Order officer lost in the field.
flavor: Like so much about the Order, this armor is ancient in its traditions, yet sacrifices little in modern construction and comfort.

name: Legate Legguards
description: Strong tactical leg protection intended for use by Order officers.

name: Lodestone Shield
description: A heat-emitting shield that leverages lodestone technology to defend and deal otherworldly damage to enemies.
flavor: The emenations from the shield's surface feels as though you are naked, as if no cloth nor armor prevents it from reaching your flesh.
summary: Lodestone Shield is a gear item placed in the Off-Hand Armaments slot of the inventory in Abiotic Factor.

name: Lucent Casque
description: Cold-worked crystal head defense with curious optical properties under certain conditions.
flavor: While the exact origins of IS-0139's crystalline appearance remain obscure, the material itself submits to many of the same techniques used to harden and reinforce similar substances on Earth.

name: Lucent Couters
description: Carefully tempered crystalline arm protection.

name: Lucent Cuirass
description: Crystalline body armor alloyed and hardened with experimental precipitates.

name: Lucent Cuisses
description: Crystal-based leg armor, reworked and deformed to increase resilience.

name: Lucky Fishing Hat
description: As lucky as it is quirky.
flavor: Or is it corky?
summary: Lucky Fishing Hat is a gear item in Abiotic Factor. The recipe, alongside Mud Waders, is unlocked when reaching Level 10 in the Fishing skill.

name: Maestro Adornments
description: Chest protection made to mimic the inhabitants of Anteverse 1, with a few creative liberties.

name: Maestro Casque
description: A helmet sewn together from paper and padding, with the melodious qualities of a cardboard box.

name: Maestro Greaves
description: A scrappy leg armor made from pieces of much taller beings.

name: Maestro Vambraces
description: A sturdy porcelain clad these arm wrappings.
flavor: Your arms feel lighter, almost as if they're being suspended by strings.

name: Makeshift Armwraps
description: Ad hoc arm protection.

name: Makeshift Backpack
description: A very small backpack made from cloth scraps.
flavor: Better than nothing, I suppose.

name: Makeshift Chestplate
description: A hastily constructed piece of body armor.
flavor: Better than nothing, probably.

name: Makeshift Helmet
description: A passable excuse for a helmet.

name: Makeshift Legwraps
description: Leg protection, of a sort.

name: Medic Helmet
description: A medic helmet of military make, adorned with strange markings.

name: Military Pack
description: A backpack of military specification.
summary: * Particle Lab, around the back of this area where there are many wooden boxes. Category:Backpack

name: Mountaineer Armguards
description: Padded and gloved, these arm guards are ready for snow - and bullets.

name: Mountaineer Chestplate
description: Padded for protection in cold climes and combat, the cozyness of this jacket-vest combination is only rivaled by its sheer weight.

name: Mountaineer Helmet
description: A helmet worn by alps-ascending assailants.

name: Mountaineer Leggings
description: As warm as they are heavy, these padded leggings are sure to keep you toasty.

name: Mud Waders
description: A pair of waterproof waders, perfect for scrounging in the muck.
summary: Wearing the Mud Waders will give the Muckraker effect, which will make it so the player only catches junk while Fishing.

name: Mushroom Helmet
description: A helmet made from the head of a fungal fiend.

name: Mystagogue Crown
description: Head armor combining a shroud-like hood over something resembling a flight helmet.
flavor: Overseen by Synaptic Labs, the design of Mystagogue field armor required an uneasy collaboration between an aerospace engineer, a materials chemist, and a Peruvian brujo.

name: Mystagogue Gaskins
description: Protective legwear constructed from an unusual blend of materials.

name: Mystagogue Glove
description: A weighty Gatekeeper's gauntlet that allows the wielder to hurl nacreous fire from their left hand.
flavor: When technology merges with knowledge retrived from a dozen half-charted anteverses, the results resemble magic.
summary: Mystagogue Glove is a weapon placed in the Off-Hand Armaments slot of the inventory in Abiotic Factor.

name: Mystagogue Shawl
description: An amalgam of ragged cape and stole over high-grade body armor.
flavor: A unique conjunction of arcane fashion and cutting-edge thermoplastics.

name: Mystagogue Wraps
description: Intricate, if heavily worn, arm defense combining aeronautic and hand-woven materials.

name: Neutrino Lantern
description: A warm, wearable light in a cold, radiation-filled universe.
summary: It emits a short-ranged yellow light source around the player character when equipped.

name: Night Helmet
description: A helmet bearing the Sigil of the Night.
flavor: One of them was said to have placed the sigil across their eyes. A curse against the enemy? A boon against the dark of Night? Regrettably, it was neither.
summary: When worn, it acts as bait for Inkfish, increases the chance of catching the base variety, and allowing the rare variant Sable Inkfish to be caught. In addition, it reduces Fatigue drain by 10% while worn.

name: Night Pass
description: A GATE-authorized pass, handy for safely traveling the halls of the Facility during after-hours.
summary: While the Night Pass is worn, the player is ignored by Security Bots, Containment Bots, and Defense Bots, unless they attack one.

name: Nucleus Helm
description: A helmet chiefly made of an alloy that no one really understands.

name: Ogre Doll
description: A dual-headed doll-like trinket of Gatekeeper provenance.
flavor: This curious, even child-like idol bears witness to the Torments of Arkus, Avatar of the Abyss.
summary: Increases damage against large enemies by 30%. Enemies affected include Armored Exor, Volatile Exor, Tarasque, Behemoth, Jotun, Bogman, Yeti, Bigogi, Security Bot, Containment Bot, Defense Bot, Corrupted Bot.

name: Order Helmet
description: A helmet of military make, adorned with strange markings.

name: Peccary Helmet
description: A helmet made from a cantankerous creature.

name: Pet Rock
description: A painted rock with googly eyes.
flavor: He's your best friend.
summary: The trinket gives +5% bonus XP for the lowest-ranked skill. Equipping the trinket will help players catch up in a skill behind the furthest.

name: Pilgrim Hat
description: A modest hat from a bygone age.
flavor: The villagers of Canaan are pious, but only slightly less than they are antiquated, suffering both in attire and reasoning.

name: Plasmatic Shield
description: An unusual but highly effective application of plasmification technology to a defensive device.
flavor: Dr. Verenkov would be proud, probably.
summary: Plasmatic Shield is a gear item placed in the Off-Hand Armaments slot of the inventory in Abiotic Factor.

name: Plastic Shield
description: A shield made from a plastic tray, reinforced with some duct tape.
summary: Plastic Shield is a gear item placed in the Off-Hand Armaments slot of the inventory in Abiotic Factor. It is used to block light enemy attacks, preventing all damage from those attacks that are blocked.

name: Plutonium Keychain
description: An extremely complicated bit of radioactive technology, but emitting a wonderful green glow all the same.
flavor: Perhaps too much green light. Also acts as a geiger counter.

name: Pocket Dimension
description: Some kind of anomalous backpack with impossibly large storage capacity.
flavor: We're dealing with things we simply can't understand, but we can sure as hell utilize.
summary: Pocket Dimension is a gear item in Abiotic Factor. It allows the player to carry more items.

name: Preacher's Hat
description: A hierophant's headdress.
flavor: While many gnostic cults eschews intermediaries, this hat seems to say 'I have answers'.

name: Puffy Coat
description: A big puffy coat with the warmth and figure of a campfire marshmallow. Made from natural insulating fibers and a little dash of science by way of thermal insulation.

name: Radiation Vest
description: A heavy laboratory vest used to block harmful radiation.
summary: It is identical to the Lead Vest, except for higher defense and a red coloration.

name: Radio Pack
description: A military backpack with some electronics attached.

name: Radion Armplates
description: Armplates of green, adorned with radioactive labelling, which prove the wearer belongs among the actinide.

name: Rat Pack
description: A large, heavy pack that does absolutely nothing for its wearer's spine or posture.
flavor: Once stuffed with scrap and supplies pilfered from the Facility, returning it to its former state is the goal of any good Rat.
summary: Rat Pack is a gear item in Abiotic Factor. It allows the player to hold additional 18 items in their inventory at expense of having no weight reduction.

name: Rat Suit
description: A hazardous environment suit adorned with odd markings. Greatly reduces radiation buildup.
flavor: Ostensibly, these "Lab Rats" are known to be as meticulous as they are unhinged. Combining deep science with utter devotion to the cause, this path has led the Rats to a field of science that may not even exist.

name: Renovo Armwraps
description: Impressive upper limb defenses contrived from unusual constituents.

name: Renovo Chestplate
description: High grade body armor from humble origins.

name: Renovo Helmet
description: Heavy duty head armor augmented by myriad found materials.
flavor: Over many incarnations, this protective wear has attained a state that is both highly functional and fairly fabulous.

name: Renovo Legwraps
description: Greatly improved, if still ad hoc leg protection.

name: Research Pack
description: A large research pack, for transporting samples from other worlds.
summary: It can hold 30 items, reduces weight by 22%, and makes radiated items in the player's inventory generate 50% less radiation. It has 1 Shielded Slot and 1 Refrigerated Slot.

name: Riot Shield
description: A heavy-duty shield originally designed for crowd-control.
summary: Riot Shield is a gear item placed in the Off-Hand Armaments slot of the inventory in Abiotic Factor.

name: Rook Helmet
description: Heavy-duty head protection from a highly aggressive attacker.
flavor: A close, but not quite perfect imitation of iconic Groupe armor, also offering some warmth.

name: Sagittarii Leggings
description: Composite leg armor acquired from an Order Sagittarii.

name: Sagittarii Stabilizers
description: Composite arm protection emblazoned with with ancient Gnostic symbols.

name: Sagittarii Stealth Plate
description: Composite body armor adorned with sigils of a recondite sect.
flavor: A large portion of the Order's symbology appears to derive from ancient Etruscan linguistic influences, with signs of more recent Levantine contribution.

name: Santa Hat
description: A festive hat from a jolly man who has no respect for the laws of physics.
flavor: Ho, ho, ho!

name: Sapper Suit
description: A hazmat suit that has seen better days, and likely no longer does the job very well. However, it seems to have a substantial amount of explosive residue coating the surface. Best to avoid open flames.
flavor: While some Saboter are volunteers, many are initially placed in this role as a punishment for Inquisitorial failings, and many come to see it for what it truly is - a pivotal role in bringing down the very structures that hold up the pomposity of man.

name: Scarab Gauntlets
description: Laminar arm protection that augments a hard-wearing chittin analogue with some stuff that was lying around.

name: Scarab Helm
description: Hardened full-face armor that melds alien exoskeletal remains and a handful of more domestic elements.

name: Scarab Plackart
description: Combines the resilience of various extraterrestrial offcuts and several material reinforcements into a formidable body armor.

name: Scarab Sabatons
description: Heavily reinforced leg defenses that combine the bone-like remains of several anteverse creatures.

name: Security Arm Guards
description: Standard-issue arm protection worn by the GATE Defense Team.

name: Security Cap
description: Standard-issue cap worn by the GATE Defense Team.
summary: There are currently two variants of the Security Cap in-game, a white and dark blue variant.

name: Security Helmet
description: Standard-issue armored helmet worn by the GATE Defense Team.

name: Security Leg Protectors
description: Standard-issue leg protection worn by the GATE Defense Team.

name: Security Pack
description: A backpack worn by the GATE Defense Team.
summary: === Office Sector === * Level 2 ** Area under Data Farm, close to a dead body with a Pest and some other items. ** Security Office locker room.

name: Security Vest
description: An armored vest worn by the GATE Defense Team.
summary: === Hydroplant === * One on top of a Office L-Desk inside the Electrical Station. * In the Waterfall Apartments, inside the room where the Voidpack recipe is found.

name: Sensory Companion
description: This multitude of eyes set amidst a fleshy red glow gives the wearer awareness in all directions.
flavor: While the Greyeb itself exhibits all the usual signs of non-sentient flora, you could swear this little guy looks at you from time to time.
summary: The Leyak and Krasue will act as if the wearer can always see it, even from behind.

name: Shifu Adornments
description: Ornate ceramic body armor, reworked to more closely mimic the inhabitants of Anteverse 1.

name: Shifu Casque
description: A helmet reconstructed to resemble finely etched porcelain.
flavor: The inscriptions appeared of their own accord, as if an attempt at communication were being made.

name: Shifu Greaves
description: Otherworldly leg protection, less fragile than it once was.

name: Shifu Vambraces
description: Arm defense more robust than its porcelain-like appearance would suggest.

name: Sigil of the Hearth
description: A symbol worn by the most fanatical members of The Order, keepers of the oldest traditions.
summary: When worn, the Sigil of the Hearth increases the quantities of ammo dropped by all Order or Gatekeeper enemies, consistently dropping the maximum possible amount whenever they drop ammo. Additionally, it increases movement speed while in combat by 10%.

name: Sniper Cowl
description: An ornate hood with a pointed crest, worn by marksmen of old, devoted traditions.
flavor: To the Sagittarii of The Order, the hood represents protection from the evils of the world, and the narrow focus required to cleanse it.

name: Snow Gloves
description: A pair of gloves sure to keep anyone warm in the most frigid conditions, when paired with other warm clothing, that is.

name: Snow Pants
description: When these pants are worn, warmth no longer becomes a need, but an entire state of being.

name: Snow Peccary Helmet
description: A helmet made from the head of a fuzzy little guy.

name: Snowman's Gettup
description: A dapper combination of scarf and hat from a frosty fellow in no need of warmth.

name: Snowman's Scarf
description: A snug scarf sourced from a strange snowy savage.

name: Snowman's Top Hat
description: A raffish silk top hat retrieved from the physical remains of IS-0127.
flavor: The most curious thing about this hat may be how thoroughly ordinary it seems.

name: Sow Helmet
description: A helmet made from the head of a purple Peccary.

name: Spuddy
description: A small potato with a chain on it. It is arguably the best charm.
flavor: You really need some friends.
summary: When worn, it increases item drop rates from enemies by a flat 5%. This does not affect items dropped when harvesting remains. The flat addition makes Spuddy more effective when farming rarer item drops, such as keys.

name: Strange Top Hat
description: A top hat with an unusual property, making it less of a hat, and more of a beaver-skin cylinder.
flavor: Immurement Registry: IS-0003
summary: Strange Top Hat is a gear item in Abiotic Factor. It is also known as The Unwearable Hat.

name: Surgical Mask
description: A cloth medical mask usually worn by doctors.

name: Swamp Hat
description: A hat worn by the eldritch witches of the Gatekeeper contingent.
flavor: They are not witches. They are warriors adorned and embellished by technology we all too easily mistake as magic or confuse for the work of the gods.

name: Swinging Censer
description: An ornate censer held by a dangling chain and bound with a few technological tweaks.
summary: When dying, the player is given the option to revive themselves. After doing so, Mercy Received is applied, imposing a cooldown time of five minutes.

name: Tarasque Helmet
description: A helmet made from the head of an enormous microbe.
flavor: Nothing that small should ever be this big.

name: Triarii Armwraps
description: Strengthened Order arm defenses, not quite general issue.

name: Triarii Chest
description: The most recent iteration of tactical body armor for the Order frontline.
flavor: One can disdain modernity without needing to renounce Kevlar.

name: Triarii Legguards
description: Basic leg protection of long-standing Order design.

name: Voidpack
description: A strange backpack with huge storage capacity.
flavor: It's probably safe to reach in there.

name: Volatile Helmet
description: A helmet refined from a volatile creature's cranium.

name: Welding Mask
description: A strong helmet to prevent welders from receiving injuries.
summary: === Manufacturing West === * In the Supply Room. * Above The Blacksmith, close to a lever that can't be activated. * Inside Shipping Logistics, on top of a metal box, close to a patrolling Grunt and close to the stairs that lead down to Inspection. * Inside Shipping, above the room where Hank Kettle is. * Inside Shipping, close to where the Fibre Optic Cable is required, in the room that leads to Alloy Handling. * In the mines area, close to some carts, in an area with water.

name: Well-worn Security Vest
description: An armored vest worn by the GATE Defense Team.
flavor: It's seen better days.

name: Witch Hat
description: A bewitchingly whimsical hat made of matted wool and leather. A bit squashed, either by age or turmoil.
flavor: It feels almost magical -- if you believe in that sort of thing.

name: Work Gloves
description: Sturdy gloves typically worn by construction workers.

name: Wreath Crown
description: A wreath delicately wrought from the leaves of an evergreen laurel.
flavor: Apollo's delusion, transmuted into a symbol of victory.

name: Yeti Helmet
description: A helmet made from the head an abominable creature.
flavor: GATE researchers at the Voussoir Facility had been studying this rare cryptid for almost half a decade. It's even rarer now.

name: Zip Shield
description: The dense 'zip' array of micro-capacitors in this personal shield generator was designed to trade defense for faster recharge speed.
summary: Produces a Hardlight Shield that blocks physical attacks. It has 200 health. It regenerates 30 shield health per second, after a delay of 4 seconds when damaged and 9 seconds when fully depleted. When the trinket is equipped, it starts at 0 shield health and has a 9 second delay before it recharges. Equipped armor values do not impact how much damage the shield can absorb.
